rules.description: Asserts the latest observation date reaches at least 2022 and freshness lag is <= 4 years for Count_BirthEvent_LiveBirth.

params.query: SELECT CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) AS latest_year, date_part('year', current_date) - CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) AS lag_years FROM stats WHERE StatVar = 'Count_BirthEvent_LiveBirth'
